title: Reference-gap report routes a spec ambiguity to the Architect
summary: A Constructor-tier agent encounters an underspecified or contradictory invariant, emits an RGR, pauses the originating task, the Architect revises the invariant (new version), and the task resumes on the new integration HEAD.

persona.role: Engineer (or LLM agent in Engineer authority)

preconditions: Sensor evidence shows a hard-gate failure that triage classifies as `reference-gap`
The cited invariant exists in the catalog at a known version

steps.action: Run `devai govern rgr emit --task-id <id> --discipline engineer --summary <text> --ambiguity <text> --evidence <EV-id> --invariant <INV-id> --question <text>` capturing the gap
steps.expected_outcome: RGR-NNNN.json persisted under .devai/state/rgr/; emitter-side record is `status: open`

steps.action: Run `devai work task pause rgr <task-id> --rgr-id RGR-NNNN`
steps.expected_outcome: Task transitions to `rgr_pending`; branch renamed `rgr/<original-branch>`; locks held but no further loop iterations attempted

steps.action: Review the RGR: read problem.ambiguity, problem.invariants_impacted, suggested questions, proposed_resolution
steps.expected_outcome: Architect decides whether the gap is real and what the clarification should be

steps.action: Revise the cited invariant: edit `docs/arch/invariants/<INV-id>.json` (statement / rationale / verification), bump its `version` field, update `docs/arch/trace.json` if needed
steps.expected_outcome: Invariant version goes from X.Y.Z to X.(Y+1).0 (or X.Y.Z to (X+1).0.0 if the statement changes substantively)

steps.action: Run `devai govern rgr resolve RGR-NNNN --resolver <name> --answer Q1=<text> --resulting-commit <sha> --resumed-task-id <new-task-id>`
steps.expected_outcome: RGR transitions to `resolved`; resolution.resumed_task_id is set

steps.action: Run `devai work task resume rgr RGR-NNNN` to relaunch the suspended task on the new integration HEAD
steps.expected_outcome: Task moves from `rgr_pending` back to `ready` (then `in_progress`); the loop runs anew against the revised invariant
alternative_paths: If Architect determines the gap is not real, mark RGR `rejected` with rationale; task remains suspended; Operator addresses via JNY-003 escalation flow instead

postconditions: Cited invariant has a newer `version` than at the time of RGR emission
Task originally paused is now `completed` (or has progressed further along the lifecycle)
The RGR record's resolution.resulting_commits[] is non-empty

acceptance_criteria.statement: A paused task does NOT transition back to in_progress until a superseding invariant version exists (Article 22 spec-revision discipline).
The RGR record's emitting_discipline is engineer | inspector | auditor (not architect or owner); Architects and Owners set the reference, they don't emit RGRs against themselves.
